How to read it:

- **measured** cases are recomputed from `decisions.jsonl`, `groups.json`, `hashes.json`, `exif_index.json`, `summary.json` and `trace.jsonl`. **historical** cases happened on runs whose outputs were later replaced; their numbers cite a committed summary or a dated, recorded decision.
- Counts are cases found, not error rates. Rates need the labelled set (`docs/EVALUATION.md`).

- No visual judgement. The proxies and contact sheets could not be viewed in the session that built this catalogue, so every case rests on scores, hashes, md5 identity and traces. Cases marked 'not visually confirmed' are numeric candidates only. Eye states are the classifier's output.
- Thumbnails: none. Per the publication rule (`docs/RESPONSIBLE_USE.md`) any thumbnail added later must be face-blurred with `blur_faces_for_publication`.

## false review (over-escalation)

### C01: P5 applied per runner-up: one human question per near-identical frame

Event E07 · severity high · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** On the first deployed E07 run P5 (margin < 0.05 -> human) ran once per runner-up. Near-identical studio bursts (up to 75 frames) produced 686 human questions and 450 reviews out of 1,000; 448 of the 450 were BURST_NOT_BEST + REVIEW_LOW_CONFIDENCE with margin 0.00.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** A reviewer would answer the same question once per frame. The review rate made the run useless.
- **Fix or mitigation:** One question per group about the keep slot (keeper + at most 2 rivals), near-identical runners-up rejected at 0.95. Rerun: 98 questions, 75 reviews (commit 83cbb17).
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (E07 diagnosis); RUN# worker_escalations 686

### C27: After the fix, P5 still asks a human on most E07 groups

Event E07 · severity medium · status **open (needs labels)** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** After the C01 fix the worker still flags more than half of E07's groups for a human, mostly 'N distinct frames within 0.05 for the keep slot'.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Reviewer load. Whether these are genuine near-ties or an over-tight margin cannot be told without the labelled set.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Tune policy.best_margin_review and best.tie_margin on E07 labels; show all asked groups of an event on one approvals page instead of one pause each (see C23).
- **Measured:**
  - E07: groups 171, groups_asked 96, groups_asked_pct 56.1, worker_escalations 98, review_verdicts 75, reasons N distinct frames within N.N for the keep slot 67, every frame failed 18, N frame(s) with a merit the keeper lacks 7, top-scored <photo> has a defect 6
  - E03: groups 27, groups_asked 10, groups_asked_pct 37, worker_escalations 11, review_verdicts 9, reasons N distinct frames within N.N for the keep slot 7, every frame failed 1, N frame(s) with a merit the keeper lacks 1, top-scored <photo> has a defect 1
  - E09: groups 50, groups_asked 10, groups_asked_pct 20, worker_escalations 22, review_verdicts 10, reasons (none recorded) 10

## exposure misjudgement

### C02: Absolute under-exposure rule fires on a dim indoor venue

Event E09 · severity high · status **fixed** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** The plan's absolute rule (clip_lo > 40 % and mean L < 45 -> under) put 307 of 661 E09 frames in review (EXPOSURE_UNDER 315). The venue is dim; faces are lit.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Darkness of the venue is not a defect; half the event went to a human.
- **Fix or mitigation:** under_flag needs the global label AND a dark subject AND frame L < 0.5 x event median (commit 8da974f). The soft label still marks about half of E09 'under', the flag fires once.
- **Measured:**
  - historical: n_photos 661, verdicts keep 312, reject 42, review 307, EXPOSURE_UNDER 315
  - E09: photos 661, label_under 327, label_over 0, under_flag 1, over_flag 0, EXPOSURE_UNDER_worker 1, EXPOSURE_OVER_worker 0, groups_mixed_soft_label 4, groups_top_decided_by_soft_label 1
- **Source:** eval/results/first-run/summary_e09_x86_untuned.json

### C03: Studio flash labelled over-exposed; the soft label still steers best-pick

Event E07 · severity medium · status **flag fixed; best-pick term open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** Studio flash and white backdrops gave 159 EXPOSURE_OVER flags on the pre-fix E07 run. The flag is now venue-relative (0 flags), but best-pick still scores exposure_ok from the soft label (ok 1 / under 0 / over 0, weight 0.15).
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Inside a mixed group the frame with the 'ok' soft label gains 0.15, a step the venue baseline already discounted. On E09 one group's top frame is decided by that term alone.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Feed exposure_ok from under_flag/over_flag or from a continuous subject-L score instead of the soft label. Partly fixed: the reason code is right, the ranking term is not.
- **Measured:**
  - E07: photos 1000, label_under 0, label_over 202, under_flag 0, over_flag 0, EXPOSURE_UNDER_worker 0, EXPOSURE_OVER_worker 0, groups_mixed_soft_label 1, groups_top_decided_by_soft_label 0
  - E09: photos 661, label_under 327, label_over 0, under_flag 1, over_flag 0, EXPOSURE_UNDER_worker 1, EXPOSURE_OVER_worker 0, groups_mixed_soft_label 4, groups_top_decided_by_soft_label 1
  - E03: photos 664, label_under 30, label_over 0, under_flag 0, over_flag 0, EXPOSURE_UNDER_worker 0, EXPOSURE_OVER_worker 0, groups_mixed_soft_label 0, groups_top_decided_by_soft_label 0
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (159 EXPOSURE_OVER pre-fix)

### C04: Agent's single-photo exposure call has no venue baseline

Event E09 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** The agent's score_exposure is a single-photo call with no event baseline (under_flag is null in its results). On the E09 local run, scripted-approved agent rows added EXPOSURE_UNDER to frames whose worker under_flag was false (frame L 29 and 42, subject L 91 and 124).
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Agent and worker disagree on the same pixels; the agent's code is the one the plan's rule rejected.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Pass the event median to the agent's exposure tool, or return the worker's flag to the agent.
- **Measured:**
  - E09: rows_adding_under 2
    - example: photo C04-p1, decided_by scripted, mean_L 29.119, subject_L 91.12, worker_codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'REVIEW_LOW_CONFIDENCE']
    - example: photo C04-p2, decided_by scripted, mean_L 42.419, subject_L 124.061, worker_codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'REVIEW_LOW_CONFIDENCE']

## false reject (risk)

### C05: Whole burst with the main subject's eyes closed: runners-up auto-rejected

Event E07 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** In 'every frame failed' groups (main subject's eyes 'closed' in every frame) the keeper is kept at confidence 0.5 and the group goes to a human, but the other frames are auto-rejected at 0.88 or more with BURST_NOT_BEST + EYES_CLOSED.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The human is asked only about the keep slot. If the closed eyes are intended (a kiss, laughter) or the classifier is wrong, the runners-up are already rejected. Reversible (nothing is deleted), but silent.
- **Fix or mitigation:** In all-failed groups put runners-up in review, or show every frame on the approval sheet.
- **Measured:**
  - E07: groups 18, sizes 2 13, 4 1, 3 3, 5 1, frames 44, auto_rejects 26, auto_reject_conf_min 0.8789
    - example: size 2, frames [{'photo': 'C05-p1', 'verdict': 'keep', 'codes': ['KEEP_BEST_OF_GROUP'], 'confidence': 0.5, 'main_p_open': [0.004, 0.2491]}, {'photo': 'C05-p2', 'verdict': 'reject', 'codes': ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'EYES_CLOSED'], 'confidence': 0.95, 'main_p_open': [0.029, 0.1178]}]
    - example: size 4, frames [{'photo': 'C05-p3', 'verdict': 'keep', 'codes': ['KEEP_BEST_OF_GROUP'], 'confidence': 0.5, 'main_p_open': [0.0003, 0.0009]}, {'photo': 'C05-p4', 'verdict': 'reject', 'codes': ['DUPLICATE_OF', 'EYES_CLOSED'], 'confidence': 0.99, 'main_p_open': [0.0094, 0.003]}, {'photo': 'C05-p5', 'verdict': 'reject', 'codes': ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'EYES_CLOSED'], 'confidence': 0.9992, 'main_p_open': [0.0003, 0.0012]}]
  - E03: groups 1, sizes 2 1, frames 2, auto_rejects 1, auto_reject_conf_min 0.9982
    - example: size 2, frames [{'photo': 'C05-p1', 'verdict': 'reject', 'codes': ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'EYES_CLOSED'], 'confidence': 0.9982, 'main_p_open': [0.0001, 0.0034]}, {'photo': 'C05-p2', 'verdict': 'keep', 'codes': ['KEEP_BEST_OF_GROUP'], 'confidence': 0.5, 'main_p_open': [0.0, 0.0006]}]

## face/eye misread

### C06: Small couple-portrait faces give eye state unknown

Event E07 · severity medium · status **by design** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** 39 % of E07 main faces get eye state 'unknown'; two thirds are smaller than 80 px (median 72 px), where the small-crop and dark-small-face rules apply. The per-face cause is not recorded.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The eyes term in best-pick becomes the neutral 0.5, so closed eyes cannot separate frames of a couple portrait shot wide.
- **Fix or mitigation:** By design (never reject on unknown). Mitigation: rerun eye state on a full-resolution crop for unknown faces (faces.detect_retry_on_unknown, off by default: 255 ms per face-free frame).
- **Measured:**
  - E07: faces_scored 1991, unknown 923, main_faces 858, main_unknown 335, main_unknown_min_px_median 72, unknown_ge_100px 71, unknown_ge_100px_max 206, main_unknown_lt_80px 227, frame_mean_L_median_unknown_ge_100px 144.7, frame_mean_L_median_read_ge_100px 146.9
  - E03: faces_scored 113, unknown 5, main_faces 57, main_unknown 0, main_unknown_min_px_median None, unknown_ge_100px 5, unknown_ge_100px_max 152, main_unknown_lt_80px 0, frame_mean_L_median_unknown_ge_100px 95.5, frame_mean_L_median_read_ge_100px 93

### C07: Eye state unknown on large, well-lit faces (>= 100 px)

Event E09 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** E09 has unknown eye state on 28 faces of 100 px or more (up to 244 px), including 17 main faces (median 186 px). Their frames are no darker than frames whose large faces were read.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Size and darkness do not explain it. Decision rows do not keep landmarks, so the cause (missing YuNet landmarks on reused metadata boxes, or a failed eye crop) cannot be recovered from outputs.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Record the unknown cause per face (no_landmarks | small | dark | crop) in the eyes result.
- **Measured:**
  - E09: faces_scored 491, unknown 190, main_faces 91, main_unknown 17, main_unknown_min_px_median 186, unknown_ge_100px 28, unknown_ge_100px_max 244, main_unknown_lt_80px 3, frame_mean_L_median_unknown_ge_100px 57.8, frame_mean_L_median_read_ge_100px 51.5
  - E07: faces_scored 1991, unknown 923, main_faces 858, main_unknown 335, main_unknown_min_px_median 72, unknown_ge_100px 71, unknown_ge_100px_max 206, main_unknown_lt_80px 227, frame_mean_L_median_unknown_ge_100px 144.7, frame_mean_L_median_read_ge_100px 146.9

### C08: Group photo with several non-main faces closed passes as keep

Event E03 · severity medium · status **partly fixed (group keepers open)** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** P3 fires REVIEW_POLICY_GROUP_EYES only when exactly one non-main face is closed. An E03 9-face frame with 5 non-main faces 'closed' was kept with no eye code; E07 has 30 such frames.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** A group photo with several blinks passes silently, the opposite of the intended direction.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Fixed for singletons and runners-up: review on >= 2 closed non-main faces or >= 1/3 of them (bd3a04b). Open for group keepers (schema forbids a review code on a keep row; no change before submission). Eye states here are the classifier's, not visually confirmed.
- **Measured (run before the fix):**
  - E03: frames 3, verdicts review 1, keep 2, max_closed 5
    - example: photo C08-p3, faces 9, non_main_closed 5, verdict keep, codes ['KEEP_BEST_OF_GROUP']
    - example: photo C08-p1, faces 3, non_main_closed 2, verdict review, codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'REVIEW_LOW_CONFIDENCE']
  - E07: frames 30, verdicts keep 4, reject 23, review 3, max_closed 3
    - example: photo C08-p3, faces 5, non_main_closed 3, verdict review, codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST', 'REVIEW_LOW_CONFIDENCE']
    - example: photo C08-p10, faces 5, non_main_closed 3, verdict reject, codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST']
  - E09: frames 2, verdicts keep 1, reject 1, max_closed 2
    - example: photo C08-p1, faces 6, non_main_closed 2, verdict keep, codes ['KEEP_BEST_OF_GROUP']
    - example: photo C08-p2, faces 6, non_main_closed 2, verdict reject, codes ['DUPLICATE_OF']
- **After the fix (cited, not yet in the S3 results):** commit bd3a04b, E07 local rerun on the same inputs: the group-eyes rule now fires on >= 2 closed non-main faces or >= 1/3 of detected non-main faces (review, never reject; unknown is not closed). A group keeper still gets no review code: reason_codes.yaml forbids review codes on keep rows, and the team decided not to change the schema before submission. The E03 9-face keeper still passes.
- **Source:** 2026-10-09 (commit bd3a04b; team decision on the remainder)

## missed duplicate / over-split burst

### C09: Byte-identical copies coded as BURST_NOT_BEST; copies disagree

Event E07 · severity low · status **fixed** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** Byte-identical copies (same md5) in E07 were mostly coded BURST_NOT_BEST, not DUPLICATE_OF, and in 13 md5 sets the judged files disagreed (e.g. one rejected, its identical twin in review).
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Two verdicts for the same bytes; the audit trail says 'weaker frame' for an identical file. The DUPLICATE metric family merges the codes, so metrics are unaffected; the UI is not.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Fixed (76f62b5): one judged file per md5 set, every other copy DUPLICATE_OF at confidence 1.0 and never asked.
- **Measured (run before the fix):**
  - E07: md5_sets 93, files_in_sets 277, copies_not_DUPLICATE_OF 139, sets_with_conflicting_verdicts 13
  - E09: md5_sets 36, files_in_sets 72, copies_not_DUPLICATE_OF 0, sets_with_conflicting_verdicts 0
- **After the fix (cited, not yet in the S3 results):** commit 76f62b5, E07 local rerun on the same inputs (verdicts unchanged 301/624/75): copies not coded DUPLICATE_OF 139 -> 0, md5 sets with conflicting verdicts 13 -> 0, DUPLICATE_OF rows 65 -> 204 (one judged file per set; copies at confidence 1.0, never asked).
- **Source:** 2026-10-09 (C09 76f62b5)

## under-split burst

### C12: Single-link chaining builds a 29-frame group of distinct frames

Event E07 · severity high · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** Single-link union-find chained a 29-frame E07 group spanning 6 s whose pHash diameter is 42 bits (86 of 406 pairs at 30 bits or more). Across 5 groups, 30 rejects are more than 20 bits from their keeper, at confidence 0.8 or more.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Visually distinct frames can be auto-rejected as BURST_NOT_BEST of a keeper they do not resemble.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Turn on cluster.refine_enabled (ORB + USAC_MAGSAC + SSIM split for groups > 8, currently false) or cap the group diameter; until then, review rejects far from the keeper.
- **Measured:**
  - E07: rejects_far_from_keeper 30, groups_with_far_rejects 5, far_reject_conf_min 0.8, widest_group size 29, phash_diameter 42, pairs_ge_30 86, pairs 406
    - example: photo C12-p5, group C12-g3, group_size 29, phash_to_keeper 37, confidence 0.8, codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST']
    - example: photo C12-p12, group C12-g3, group_size 29, phash_to_keeper 33, confidence 0.99, codes ['BURST_NOT_BEST']

## sharpness misjudgement

### C13: Face-ROI sharpness ends 'borderline' on very sharp frames

Event E07 · severity low · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** 83 E07 frames are labelled 'borderline' on the faces ROI although lap_var is at least 696 (sharp threshold 120): fft_hf on small face crops stays below 10 and BRISQUE is not used on face ROIs, so the votes disagree.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The label is wrong and lowers confidence; it did not cause a reject on its own (those 71 rejects are burst runners-up). The BRISQUE value is null in every decision row of all three runs.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Scale fft_hf_blurry_max with ROI size or drop the FFT vote below a minimum ROI; ship the BRISQUE model files in the worker image or document 'BRISQUE off'.
- **Measured:**
  - E07: photos 1000, brisque_null 1000, borderline 83, borderline_roi faces 83, borderline_lap_var_min 696.1, borderline_fft_hf_max 9.97, lap_sharp_min 120, borderline_verdicts keep 8, reject 71, review 4
  - E03: photos 664, brisque_null 664, borderline 0, borderline_roi , borderline_lap_var_min None, borderline_fft_hf_max None, lap_sharp_min 120, borderline_verdicts 
  - E09: photos 661, brisque_null 661, borderline 0, borderline_roi , borderline_lap_var_min None, borderline_fft_hf_max None, lap_sharp_min 120, borderline_verdicts 

## agent tool loop

### C14: Malformed resume decision: write_decision retried until recursion limit

Event probe · severity high · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** AgentCore probe: a resume decision with `action` instead of `human_verdict` was accepted; write_decision([]) raised and the planner retried identically (no retry cap; tool errors reset the blocked-call counter) until Python's recursion limit (about 320 Strands turns), on AgentCore and the local HTTP runtime.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** A typo in a reviewer payload crashed the agent instead of returning an error.
- **Fix or mitigation:** validate_decisions before every resume ({"status":"error"}, run stays paused), retry cap on write_decision, failures count toward the six-in-a-row stop, 80-turn chunks (commit 3b02852).
- **Source:** 2026-10-08 (AgentCore probe; recursion root cause, 3b02852)

### C15: Pivot detector read 0 pivots from the real agent trace

Event E09 · severity medium · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** The API's pivot detector found 0 pivots in the real E09 trace: tool results are per_photo lists and make_contact_sheet sits between the cause and request_human_approval.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The UI's evidence for 'the agent changed course because of a tool result' was empty on real data.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Detector reads per_photo results and skips helper tools; real run now shows 20 pivots (commit e708b01).
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (pivot GAP; commit e708b01: 20 pivots)

### C16: Agent wrote the group-eyes code for a closed main face

Event E09 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** On the E09 local run the agent re-coded 3 frames the worker had rejected as DUPLICATE_OF + EYES_CLOSED (main face closed, e.g. p_open 0.06/0.04) to review with REVIEW_POLICY_GROUP_EYES, a code defined for one closed NON-main face. The scripted reviewer approved them.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The delivered reason code describes a different defect; reason metrics would bucket it wrongly.
- **Fix or mitigation:** write_decision checks codes against per-face evidence (main closed -> EYES_CLOSED).
- **Measured:**
  - E09: rows 3
    - example: photo C16-p1, decided_by scripted, verdict review, worker_verdict reject, worker_codes ['DUPLICATE_OF', 'EYES_CLOSED'], worker_conf 0.99
    - example: photo C16-p2, decided_by scripted, verdict review, worker_verdict reject, worker_codes ['DUPLICATE_OF', 'EYES_CLOSED'], worker_conf 0.99

## data/pipeline

### C17: Originals never synced: 83 frames NoSuchKey

Event E07 · severity high · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** 83 E07 frames failed with NoSuchKey on the first deployed run: the worker fetched originals for borderline frames and originals/<E07>/ had never been synced.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Partial run; the failed frames had no verdict.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Missing original falls back to the processed image; ingest fails fast when raw/ < manifest; CullEvent runs PlanOriginals + SyncOriginals (commit 946d07c, commit 80b1410).
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (NoSuchKey root cause)

### C18: Originals arrive after the worker, so P2 never uses them

Event E07 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** No sharpness result in any of the three runs used the original: CullEvent copies originals after the worker (between worker and agent), and the agent's sharpness calls also ran on processed images.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** P2's last step (re-score on the original) never runs; the 870 originals copied for E07 are unused.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Copy originals for group candidates before the worker's P2 pass, or let the agent request variant=original. Low impact today: these galleries have no borderline frames (C21).
- **Measured:**
  - E07: photos 1000, variant_original 0, chains_with_original_step 0, variant_fallback 0
  - E03: photos 664, variant_original 0, chains_with_original_step 0, variant_fallback 0
  - E09: photos 661, variant_original 0, chains_with_original_step 0, variant_fallback 0

### C19: EXIF without offset: the reception-hour guard reads the wrong hour

Event E09 · severity medium · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** E09 and E07 EXIF has no OffsetTimeOriginal. local_hour() then takes clickedAt (camera wall time stored with a Z) and adds IST, so the hour is 5-6 h late: the reception-hour window flips for about half of both events. Seen directly in the agent trace: hour 1 for a photo whose EXIF says 20:00; the worker calls the same local_hour() but does not store the hour.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** P6 (artistic-intent guard) reads the wrong hour. No verdict changed on these runs (no motion-blur frames), so this is latent.
- **Fix or mitigation:** When the offset is unknown, use the EXIF wall-clock hour as local time instead of shifting it.
- **Measured:**
  - E09: photos 661, tz_unknown 661, reception_window_flips 318, hour_shift 6 315, 5 346
  - E07: photos 1000, tz_unknown 1000, reception_window_flips 554, hour_shift 6 742, 5 258
  - E03: photos 664, tz_unknown 1, reception_window_flips 0, hour_shift 5 1

### C20: Worker and agent both wrote RUN# fields

Event E07 · severity medium · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** Worker and agent both upserted RUN# started_at/ended_at/escalation_count on E07: ended_at < started_at and 686 'escalations' that were the worker's flags.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Run banner and metrics showed a negative duration and a wrong escalation count.
- **Fix or mitigation:** started_at via if_not_exists, worker_*/agent_* namespaced fields, ended_at only when terminal (commit 1597284, commit 946d07c).
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (two-writer clash); RUN# run_note

### C21: Pre-culled galleries: no borderline-sharpness frames to test on

Event E03 · severity medium (for claims) · status **by design (data)** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** All three events are pre-culled by the photographer: no frame has lap_var below 120 and there are 0 BLUR_* codes.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Blur recall and the P2 face-ROI rescore cannot be measured or demonstrated on this data.
- **Fix or mitigation:** By design of the data. Needs a team-owned test shoot or a labelled degraded copy (docs/EVALUATION.md §6).
- **Measured:**
  - E03: photos 664, lap_var_below_sharp_min 0, blur_codes 0, lap_var_p5 922.7
  - E07: photos 1000, lap_var_below_sharp_min 0, blur_codes 0, lap_var_p5 1733.6
  - E09: photos 661, lap_var_below_sharp_min 0, blur_codes 0, lap_var_p5 897.3

## HITL ergonomics

### C22: Reviewer asked to choose between identical files

Event E07 · severity medium · status **fixed** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** 13 E07 groups ask the reviewer to choose between tied candidates of which two are the same file (same md5). On E09 the agent asked 3 questions whose keep and review proposals were identical files, and said so in its own reasoning.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Wasted reviewer time and a confusing choice between two identical thumbnails.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Fixed with C09 (76f62b5): copies are DUPLICATE_OF before ranking, so tied candidates are distinct files.
- **Measured (run before the fix):**
  - E07: groups 13, asked_with_identical_files 13, agent_questions_all_identical 0
    - example: size 24, candidates 3, distinct_files 2, needs_approval True
    - example: size 9, candidates 3, distinct_files 2, needs_approval True
  - E09: groups 0, asked_with_identical_files 0, agent_questions_all_identical 4
- **After the fix (cited, not yet in the S3 results):** commit 76f62b5, E07 local rerun: groups asking a human about identical files 13 -> 0. The agent-side duplicate proposals on E09 (3) were on the old E09 local run and are not re-measured.
- **Source:** 2026-10-09 (with C09)

### C23: One question per pause; the reviewer waits for the next group

Event E09 · severity low · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** Every agent pause carries exactly one item. After a resume the next pause comes about 40-50 s later (10 pauses on the E09 local run, 7 across the E03 runs).
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The reviewer answers one group, then waits for the agent to reach the next one.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Collect all approval items of a batch before interrupting, or let the API queue worker-flagged groups directly.
- **Measured:**
  - E09: interrupts 11, items_per_interrupt 1 11, resume_to_next_pause_s_median 49.2, resume_to_next_pause_s_max 86.4, worker_escalations 22
  - E03: interrupts 7, items_per_interrupt 1 7, resume_to_next_pause_s_median 40.7, resume_to_next_pause_s_max 68.3, worker_escalations 11

### C24: Kept frame is not the top-ranked frame; text shows a negative margin

Event E07 · severity low · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** When the top-ranked frame has a defect (e.g. EYES_CLOSED) the next frame is kept; the margin is then negative and the reason text says 'margin -0.xx'.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** The behaviour is right; the text reads like an error to a photographer.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Report the margin against the best non-defective rival and say 'top frame skipped: eyes closed'.
- **Measured:**
  - E07: groups 6, margin_min -0.2156, reason_text_negative_margin 6
  - E03: groups 1, margin_min -0.0043, reason_text_negative_margin 1

### C25: No real human answer yet: approvals are scripted or team tests

Event E09 · severity high (for claims) · status **open** · measured

- **What the pipeline did:** No escalation has a photographer's answer: E09's answers are scripted, earlier E03 answers were team mechanism tests (human_source lead_test), E07 is waiting.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Any 'human agreed with the agent' figure would be invented.
- **Fix or mitigation:** Agreement counts only human_source ui|file|http. Needs a real reviewer session.
- **Measured:**
  - E09: answered_rows 24, decided_by scripted 21, agent 3, human_source scripted 21, None 3, needs_approval_rows 22
  - E03: answered_rows 0, decided_by , human_source , needs_approval_rows 20
  - E07: answered_rows 0, decided_by , human_source , needs_approval_rows 211

### C26: Scripted approvals shown as a person; 0.5 decision shown as 100 %

Event E09 · severity high (for claims) · status **fixed** · historical

- **What the pipeline did:** Scripted approvals rendered as 'Decided by a person', and a 0.5 decision showed 100 % confidence.
- **Why it is wrong or risky:** Misleading provenance in the judge-facing UI.
- **Fix or mitigation:** human_source / decided_by=scripted|lead_test stamped and rendered distinctly; confidence shows the agent's number (2026-10-05).
- **Source:** 2026-10-05 (human_source; commit e708b01)

`docs/EVALUATION.md` §2 categories with no instance in these three runs (checked, so not catalogued as cases):

- E03: cameras 2, cross_camera_pairs_le_8 0; photos 664, exif_rows 664, no_capture_time 0; groups 27, size2 25, adjacent_within_window 2, adjacent_min_link_le_12 0
- E07: cameras 1, cross_camera_pairs_le_8 0; photos 1000, exif_rows 1000, no_capture_time 0; groups 171, size2 66, adjacent_within_window 74, adjacent_min_link_le_12 11
- E09: cameras 2, cross_camera_pairs_le_8 0; photos 661, exif_rows 661, no_capture_time 0; groups 50, size2 49, adjacent_within_window 4, adjacent_min_link_le_12 0
- Burst split across cameras: 0 cross-camera pairs within 8 pHash bits in E03 and E09 (2 cameras each); E07 has one camera.
- Missing EXIF: every photo of the three events has a capture time.
- HEIC originals: every manifest original_key is .jpg in all three events. Watermarked processed images: not checked (no watermark detector exists; file names carry no marker).
- Two-frame groups on E09 and E03 (49 of 50 and 25 of 27 groups): no adjacent groups there come within 12 pHash bits, so there is no sign of over-splitting; the team judged E09's sizes genuine (2026-10-05).
- Intentional closed eyes, artistic motion blur, bokeh portraits, glasses glare: plausible, but they need visual review or labels to identify; none is claimed here.
